classification.analysis: "The Mother of AI Project" is a free, week-by-week open-source course that walks learners through building a production-grade agentic RAG system (an arXiv paper research assistant) from scratch, with a search-first philosophy: solid BM25 keyword search before adding vectors. Each of its seven weeks adds a layer -- Docker/FastAPI/PostgreSQL infrastructure, an Airflow-driven arXiv ingestion pipeline, OpenSearch BM25 retrieval, hybrid keyword+vector search with chunking, a full RAG pipeline with a local LLM and Gradio UI, Langfuse monitoring with Redis caching, and finally a LangGraph agentic RAG workflow with document grading, query rewriting, guardrails, and a Telegram bot front end. It targets engineers who want a hands-on, tagged-release-per-week path to production RAG, each paired with a companion Jupyter notebook and Substack blog post.

use_cases.title: Follow a week-by-week hands-on course to build a production RAG system
Learn hybrid BM25 plus vector search before jumping to embeddings-only RAG
Reference a LangGraph agentic RAG workflow with grading, rewriting, and guardrails
See a full RAG stack wired together: FastAPI, Airflow, Postgres, Langfuse, Redis
